name: context-trim
description: Every N% of context fill, Haiku picks the transcript messages that no longer matter and the mod drops them, with no summary

step.title: Trim every
step.description: Percent of context fill between trims. Each trim rewrites history and invalidates the prompt cache, so small steps cost more than they save.

keepRecent.title: Messages kept untouched
keepRecent.description: How many of the latest messages a trim never drops (the first message is always kept).

model.title: Judge model
model.description: Model alias or id that picks the messages to drop.

enabled.title: Trimming
enabled.description: off: nothing is watched or dropped.
